Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
James Hamblin <je...@cornell.edu> writes:
>Question about the superior on this card: does the tapping happen as a
>result of the successful action (as the card text unfortunately seems to
>indicate), or does it happen at declaration (as I read it, and makes it
>useful and worth the large cost)?

Propaganda Combat Presence 2 blood
Normal: (D) Bleed with +1 bleed. Vampires with titles cannot block this
action.
Superior: As above, and the Methuselah you are bleeding taps one of his
or her ready minions.
Artist: Ken Meyer, Jr. Rarity: Uncommon

The tapping is a part of the successful action.
I would guess that she would have to tap one of her untapped
minions (and errata to that effect should be assumed to exist).
